headline: A steady day to finish what you started
overview: The Moon supports patience and clear thinking today. Small, careful steps will move you further than big promises, and a calm word at home sets a good tone for the evening.
love: Listen more than you speak with someone close to you; they will notice the care.
career: A pending task can be completed if you set aside distraction for an hour in the morning.
money: Good day to review your monthly plan and keep spending simple.
health: Drink enough water and take a short walk after meals.
tip: Begin the day with five minutes of quiet breathing.
